obligations.behavior: Hold busy_sticky and suppress flags_valid when enable_int is 0 on the final operation of a multi-op loop body (~busy_int), so that flags_o.valid only asserts after all nb_ops operations execute under enable_int=1 and no half-updated results or skipped iterations occur across stalls in SHADOWED=1 or SHADOWED=0.
verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (shadowed and unshadowed multi-op stall checks on flags_o.valid)

obligations.behavior: When flags_o.valid is 1 on a non-terminal iteration result (!flags_o.done), flags_o.loop must report the loop index (0..NB_LOOPS-1) whose body just completed to produce flags_o.offs, flags_o.idx, and flags_o.idx_update in both SHADOWED=1 and SHADOWED=0.

Both clear_i and ctrl_i.clear synchronously reset all internal and shadowed state (including shadow_flags_wr, shadow_flags_rd, out_valid, and out_loop) and block enable_int during the clear cycle, leaving flags_o.valid, flags_o.done, flags_o.offs, flags_o.idx, flags_o.idx_update, flags_o.loop (and flags_o.ready in SHADOWED=1) at 0 on the following cycle and starting the next job cleanly from iteration 0.
verified_by: private/tests/tb.sv (post-clear and mid-body clear checks for ctrl_i.clear and clear_i in SHADOWED=1 and SHADOWED=0)
